claim: Patchline ships a proof minimization engine emitting the smallest checkable witness for each verdict. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the proof minimization claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make proof-minimization-engine-gate`.
